name: OVHcloud
guide:
Create the token at https://<endpoint>/createToken/ (e.g. https://eu.api.ovh.com/createToken/) and grant ONLY these rights, repeated for every zone this profile manages (replace <zone>):
  GET    /domain/zone/<zone>/*
  POST   /domain/zone/<zone>/*
  PUT    /domain/zone/<zone>/*
  DELETE /domain/zone/<zone>/*
No other paths are needed. Use one profile per OVH account; a profile can manage several zones of the same account.

name: Cloudflare

fields.label: API token
fields.help: Zone.DNS:Edit permission, restricted to the zones this profile manages.

fields.label: Zone read token (optional)
fields.help: Only needed when the API token is limited to specific zones and cannot list them: a token with Zone.Zone:Read on all zones.

guide: Create an API token (not the global API key) with permission Zone → DNS → Edit, and under Zone Resources include only the zones this profile manages.

name: Gandi
guide: Create a personal access token restricted to the organisation and domains this profile manages, with only the 'Manage domain name technical configurations' permission.

name: Infomaniak
guide: Create an API token in the Infomaniak manager with only the 'Domain' scope.

name: Amazon Route 53

fields.label: Hosted zone ID (optional)
fields.help: Set it when the IAM policy does not allow route53:ListHostedZonesByName.

guide: Create an IAM user whose policy allows route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets and route53:ListResourceRecordSets on arn:aws:route53:::hostedzone/<zone-id> only, plus route53:ListHostedZonesByName and route53:GetChange.
